in_marathi.name: Ansuya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wish, Desire, Delight
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ansuya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ansuya is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘ansu’, which means ‘desire’ or ‘wish’. In Hindu mythology, Ansuya is the name of a divine river, a celestial nymph, and a queen. She is known for her gentle nature and compassionate heart.

vedic_reference.note: Ansuya is the name of the divine goddess Annapurna, who is the goddess of food, nourishment, and the harvest. She is the wife of Lord Shiva and is known to fulfill the desires and bestow happiness upon her devotees.
